text_block_list.text: Huff... huff! Wheeze! Puff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (My legs! I'm going to fa—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hold on, I've got you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You ran spectacularly, Dober. Can<n>you walk?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Air Groove... I'm sorry... You don't<n>have to—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Lean on me all you want, and don't<n>talk unless you
really must. I'll walk<n>with you to the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your fans are awaiting your<n>triumphant return,
champion.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Fans
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo! Dober! Dober! You were<n>incredible!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Urgh...

(...It's useless. I don't have the<n>energy to face
them...)

text_block_list.name: Groove's Fans
text_block_list.text: Air Groove! You were so, so close!<n>You did great!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Air Groove...)
Will I ever be able to carry myself like<n>her?
At the very least...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wow. I can't believe Mejiro Dober<n>clinched the
win! But... she's barely<n>standing. Do you think
she's okay?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, yeah, she certainly doesn't<n>have
McQueen's consistency. I doubt<n>she'll be able to
snag a victory next<n>time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The following day, I find myself<n>watching the rain
come down from<n>inside my office.

I'm trying to get some work done in<n>my office
when Mejiro Dober walks<n>in.
choice_data_list: You want to use my TV? What for?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright told me that a program about<n>this year's
classic racers is about to<n>start.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They'll probably cover yesterday's<n>Arima Kinen
too. I figured I should<n>give it a watch.
choice_data_list: Oh, good idea!
Oh, good idea!

text_block_list.text:
Since Mejiro Dober managed to<n>come in first at the
Arima Kinen<n>yesterday, the program is bound to
feature her prominently!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully, this will help convince her<n>that she's
getting closer to building a<n>new Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Is that a yes? I'll turn it on, then.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Moving on... Didn't Dober's<n>performance at the
Japanese Oaks<n>remind you of Mejiro Ramonu?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the Dark Duchess! She sure was<n>something. I
still have the image of<n>her running etched in my
mind!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
We can't talk about the Arima Kinen<n>without
mentioning Mejiro Palmer<n>and her back-to-back
Grand Prix<n>victories! Her runaway style is the<n>stuff
of dreams.
choice_data_list: (What the...)

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Mejiro Bright win the Triple<n>Crown also
brought back memories<n>of Mejiro Ryan. You can't
help but<n>want to cheer for her, you know?

text_block_list.name: Commentator C
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. And we mustn't forget the<n>spring Tenno
Sho if we're talking<n>about the Mejiro family!
Mejiro<n>McQueen was so impressive in it!
As the segment continues, Legaciesof the Mejiro Family flashes acrossthe screen, and footage of pastMejiros' feats is played back.

The commentators continue lauding<n>the bygone
Mejiros' achievements,<n>and the social media
comments at the<n>bottom of the screen do much the
same.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: And that's how the program ends.
What...
choice_data_list: What the hell was that?!
What the hell was that?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The words fly from my trembling lips<n>without me
realizing.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright and Mejiro Dober<n>have done
fantastically throughout<n>their classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And yet, no one was praising them<n>for their
accomplishments. It was as if<n>they were just there
to help highlight<n>the other racers.
choice_data_list: That was ridiculous!

text_block_list.text: Trainer... Let it go.
choice_data_list: But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I said let it go! To be honest, I knew<n>this would
happen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday during the Arima Kinen, I<n>could tell how
intense the senior<n>racers were—and how
inadequate I<n>was next to them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The people I admire—Ramonu, Ryan,<n>and so many
more—are on a level so<n>high, I can't even
comprehend it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It was fine when all I was doing was<n>blindly
worshipping them. I was<n>simply proud and dazzled
by how<n>brilliantly Ryan and the others shone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I thought all I had to do was follow<n>directly in their
footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't until I started chasing after<n>them in
earnest that I realized how<n>crushingly steep the trail
they blazed<n>is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And the closer I get to their light, the<n>more I find
myself imprisoned in their<n>shadows!
choice_data_list: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...They're so far away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I promised Bright that we'd forge<n>new legacies as
the next generation<n>of Mejiros, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I didn't realize how unfathomably far<n>I would have
to go in order to reach<n>that light.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm still so weak... so pathetic...
choice_data_list: But you've never given up!
But you've never given up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She looks up in surprise, and I lock<n>eyes with her.
choice_data_list:
And I should know. I've been by your side this
whole time.

And I should know. I've been by your side this
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I'll tell her as many times as I need,<n>but Mejiro
Dober did an incredible<n>job during her classic year.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I haven't managed to<n>stop my
shaking...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Despite knowing the real reason why<n>I shake, I'm
still scared. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard she was<n>trembling or how
dispirited she felt,<n>she always rose to the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I know better than anyone how<n>brilliant the mark
she's left on racing<n>history is.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I know how much work she's put in<n>over the past
two years, trying to<n>forge her legacy.
choice_data_list:
I won't let anyone look down on all your hard
work! Not even you!

I won't let anyone look down on all your hard
work! Not even you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't care how many times I have<n>to say it until
she believes me. I'll say<n>it a million times if I have
to.
choice_data_list: Mejiro Dober, you are an incredible racer.
Mejiro Dober, you are an incredible racer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ... All right, I'm mad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm so mad and disappointed,Trainer! Hic... Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The pounding rain that falls on the turf<n>outside
seems to mirror the stream of<n>tears spilling down
Mejiro Dober's<n>cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I know it's my job to wipe her tears,<n>but I can't
stop my own from falling.<n>Tearfully, we swear to
make a<n>comeback from this.
And before we know it, the rain stops.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: We still haven't discussed our next<n>goal, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to run in the Osaka Hai.
choice_data_list:
That's one of the races in the senior spring Triple
Crown!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai, the spring Tenno Sho,<n>and the
Takarazuka Kinen comprise<n>the conventional path
the best senior<n>racers take.
choice_data_list: All the more reason to run in it, right?
All the more reason to run in it, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. I don't want to give up the<n>fight. And I'm
not going to abandon<n>the promise I made with
Bright. Not<n>yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We still have to forge new Mejiro<n>legacies
together!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is now the Osaka Hai!<n>We'll shoot the
flare signaling Mejiro<n>Dober's comeback right
there amid<n>the cherry trees at Hanshin!
